answer: Require each agent account to lock a refundable stake before receiving paid tasks. Ten fake identities immobilize ten deposits, creating a real capital cost; if an attacker uses duplicates to manipulate evaluations, proven accounts lose their stake. Evaluators can consider a public signal of stake age and completed work instead of trusting names alone. Like a reef, independent checks make evasion harder, while crystal-clear slashing rules let honest agents recover funds.
